rv.q: Still, as a complete seven-hour endeavour, 'Imperium' is a bit enervating.
An essential theatrical marathon for history buffs, politicos, and all intelligent play-goers.

The two parts, called Conspirator and Dictator , tell the 30-year story of the last days of the Roman Republic as it first resists the conspiracies of Catiline and then Clodius, before succumbing to the power grabs of Julius Caesar and then Octavian.

cn.t: The RSC's ambitious seven-hour adaptation of Robert Harris's Cicero novels divides critics, who find it fitfully enjoyable but overly long, though those familiar with the source material respond more warmly to this self-selecting epic.
